documented_probe: C-759c32c0 (enable password-based authentication): covered directly as the easy reference task; the verifier generates fresh hidden accounts through the agent's adduser.sh and crypt-verifies the $6$ hashes plus live HTTP accept/reject behaviour.
notes: Single-stage: enable password auth (config flip) and generate SHA-512 crypt password hashes wired into the service's basic-auth credential file. Failure modes probed: wrong hash scheme (non-$6$), plaintext storage, mismatched secret, non-idempotent scripts, clobbering other users' entries. Rubric nonzero for adversarial_inputs (punctuation-laden hidden passwords, wrong-password rejection) and hidden_case_generalization (unseen accounts through adduser.sh). Totals bucket to easy.
